audience: Codex operators and Decodex Control Plane maintainers
text: Codex MultiAgentV2 renamed its trigger-turn tool: assign_task is now followup_task. PR #25636 keeps legacy rollout-trace classification for assign_task, so old traces still reduce correctly. Operator takeaway: audit v2 tool lists. https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/25636
evidence_notes: Chrome account menu was switched to and read back as @decodexspace before any compose action.
A focused X search for from:decodexspace followup_task assign_task returned No results, so no duplicate publication was observed.
The upstream review and upstream impact artifacts classify PR #25636 as confirmed operator-impact evidence for the MultiAgentV2 tool rename.
The browser safety policy requires action-time human confirmation before creating a public X post, so automation failed closed before composing or submitting.

claims.text: Codex MultiAgentV2 renamed the trigger-turn tool from assign_task to followup_task.
PR #25636 keeps legacy rollout-trace classification for assign_task.
Decodex operators should audit v2 tool-list assumptions before adopting newer schemas.

decision.reason: Source-backed MultiAgentV2 rename affects operator expectations and Decodex compatibility planning, but live X submission requires action-time human confirmation.

failure.details: Chrome verified @decodexspace and duplicate search found no existing matching post, but automation stopped before compose or submit because creating a public X post requires action-time human confirmation under the browser safety policy.

caveats: The candidate media artifact was prepared from an existing checked-in generated decodex_signal_card image because the image generation result was not exposed as a local file path in this run.
Retry publication only after action-time human confirmation is available in the publishing workflow.
